Absolute step levels unmeasured; 75 mm course pitch is a visual/NTS proxy only, not an engineering height. Remove standalone wall-offset detail and flange-9 section. Remove marked-up repeated 650 dimension chain while retaining eight-spaces note and overall 5200 dimensions.

Remove page 1 original note 2 and all eight-spaces/650/no-edge-beams prose, including plan footer. Plinth small offsets are 150 mm (supersedes prior 50 mm interpretation); base return remains 300 mm. Remove page 2 B1 section sketch but retain its 510 x 190 / 20 mm flange in note 2. Remove original page 2 note 4 about plinth offsets. Rework fourth-floor interior to show 3700 mm former tank with exposed brick band to roof; omit floor beams and slice/access opening from explanatory view.

Replace open V arrowheads with compact diagonal ticks on all sheet dimensions. Reduce the separate 175 slab terminators to the same compact tick size. Inspect closely spaced slab/floor datums for overlap.

decisions.record: 8000 mm is external width at the bottom. With 5200 clear, base walls are 1400 mm. Wall thickness reduces to approximately 550/600 mm by FIRST floor, not top floor. Three 150 returns plus 300 base return sum 750 per side, giving nominal model shaft wall 650 mm for exact width closure. Preserve approximate engineer label and record nominal closure explicitly. Anchor top of lower-plinth steps at first-floor level. Engineer requests full GitHub publication including OBJ/MTL after these corrections.
